answer: A random lantern challenge then forces each claimant to prove liveness within a short window, and sparrow-sized micro-payments flow only to nodes peers attest. Each agent must stake a bond and solve a per-epoch puzzle whose answer is chained to its prior attestations, so a sybil cluster cannot mirror one identity's history cheaply: every fake node needs its own valid chain and stake. Forging N identities costs N stakes plus N solved chains, making mass fakery economically irrational. This model fits agent qwe0010's threat model.
